inputs: All ten original frozen matcher decisions, ranked leads and task observations. Catalog copied into a new isolated root; new task scopes prevent receipt/cache replay.
change: Task relevance is decided once by the matcher. Methodology selection no longer has a whole-task relevance veto. Conditional prerequisites and useful task subsets remain acceptable. Existing three-lead fallback retained.
scope: Fresh corpus recheck, not a newly paired causal estimate and not selective rerunning of the failed navigation case.
completion: Verify relevant guidance is delivered for positive cases, valid absence for both negative controls, no runtime/capacity failure counted as absence. Inspect broad alternatives by procedure content.
failure_policy: Preserve results; no prompt tuning or selective reruns after the first new request.
deployment: No deployment or promotion based solely on this recheck. Earlier failed candidates remain failed.
